{{Quote|Why have you asked us to meet you, Master Sazen?|Ahn Rasi Tuum, to Wolf Sazen|<ref name="Legacy 2" />}}
'''Ahn''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and one of the '''Rasi Tuums''', a [[Rasi Tuum family|trio]] of [[Litter (biology)|littermates]] that also included [[Zho Rasi Tuum|Zho]] and another who went by only [[Rasi Tuum]]. They were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], they served in the [[New Jedi Order]]. All three Rasi Tuums survived an [[Massacre at Ossus|attack]] against the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] by the [[One Sith]] in [[130 ABY]], with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order being dispersed across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[137 ABY|Seven years later]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Ahn traveled to the planet [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] to [[Ambush on Daluuj|rendezvous]] with Jedi Master [[Wolf Sazen]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]], and another Jedi. As Ahn and the group were discussing the possibility of searching for Sazen's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Cade Skywalker]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] revealed themselves by impaling Ahn with a [[Spear/Legends|spear]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|throwing]] him from the [[bridge]] where the meeting was taking place into a ravine, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Cathar. Vao and Sazen ultimately defeated the Sith, and resolved to find Cade Skywalker.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My former master still seeks Cade Skywalker.''"<br />"''It's been ''seven years'' since the fall of Ossus! Not one word has been heard of Cade Skywalker. He ''must'' be dead!|Shado Vao and Ahn Rasi Tuum|<ref name="Legacy 2" />}}
[[File:RasiTuumDeath-SWL02.jpg|thumb|left|240px|The death of Ahn Rasi Tuum]]
Ahn was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Sith–Imperial War]]<ref name="Date">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]] establishes that [[Rasi Tuum]] and his littermates were active [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|Battle of Coruscant]], which is dated at [[130 ABY]] in [[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]].</ref> as one of the [[Rasi Tuum family|Rasi Tuums]], along with [[Litter (biology)|littermates]] [[Zho Rasi Tuum|Zho]] and another who went by the name [[Rasi Tuum]].<ref name="Legacy 25" /> Ahn and his<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> littermates were found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and were subsequently trained as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]],<ref name="Legacy 0" /> with Ahn eventually ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]].<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> Near the end of the Sith&ndash;Imperial War in [[130 ABY]], the [[One Sith]] attacked the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and the [[New Jedi Temple|one]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to fracture the Jedi.<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> The Rasi Tuums ultimately survived the massacre,<ref name="Legacy 25" /> spending the next seven years hiding from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who were on a [[Third Jedi Purge|campaign]] to hunt down the Jedi.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]],<ref name="Legacy 2" /> Ahn traveled to the planet [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] after [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]] convinced him to meet with Master [[Wolf Sazen]] to discuss the status of the fractured Jedi Order.<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> Ahn and Vao rendezvoused with Sazen and another Jedi over one of Daluuj's [[bridge]]s and began discussing matters, including that of locating Sazen's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Cade Skywalker]], whom most believed was [[Death/Legends|deceased]]&mdash;including Ahn. Unbeknownst to Ahn and his fellow Jedi, a team of five Sith were hiding in the shadows, preparing to ambush the four Jedi. As Sazen finished expressing his belief that successfully finding Skywalker was vital, Ahn was impaled through his chest by a [[Spear/Legends|spear]], which was thrown by one of the Sith. The Cathar Jedi was then [[Telekinesis/Legends|thrown]] over the bridge into the ravine by the Sith,<ref name="Legacy 2" /> killing him.<ref name="Legacy 25" /> After Vao and Sazen defeated the Sith that had killed Ahn and the other Jedi, the duo resolved to find Cade Skywalker.<ref name="Legacy 2" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It is dangerous for more than one Jedi to gather in a single place these days. If it's not bounty hunters, it's the Sith.|Ahn Rasi Tuum, just prior to the ambush|<ref name="Legacy 2" />}}
[[File:Threerasituums.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Ahn Rasi Tuum and his brothers]]
Unlike most Jedi,<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> Ahn believed that the prospect of Jedi survivors meeting with each other was dangerous due to the bounty hunters and Sith that were searching for them.<ref name="Legacy 2" /> However, that did not stop him from agreeing to go with Shado Vao<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> and meet with Wolf Sazen on Daluuj. At the beginning of the meeting with Sazen, Ahn expressed his doubts about meeting with each other. He also opined that the Zabrak's former Padawan, Cade Skywalker, was deceased<ref name="Legacy 2" /> and refused to believe Sazen when he insisted that Skywalker was alive.<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> Ahn was similar in appearance to his littermates.<ref name="Legacy 0" />

==Powers and abilities==
Along with the other Rasi Tuums, Ahn managed to survive the Sith's initial assault against the Jedi Order.<ref name="Legacy 25" /> After the Massacre of Ossus, he avoided detection by the Sith and bounty hunters until his death at the hands of the Sith at the ambush on Daluuj.<ref name="Legacy 2" />

==Equipment==
Ahn wore a [[Color/Legends|brown]] set of [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and allowed his long brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] to flow past his shoulders. His [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were green, and he also sported a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]].<ref name="Legacy 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rasi Tuums were created by writer [[John Ostrander]] and artist [[Jan Duursema]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series and were first featured as an image in the resource comic [[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]].<ref name="Legacy 0" /> One of the Rasi Tuums made an appearance in the series' [[Legacy (2006) 2|second issue]], in which he was not identified and perished,<ref name="Legacy 2" /> but a living Master Rasi Tuum appeared in [[2008]] in the [[Legacy (2006) 25|twenty-fifth issue]] and established that he was a separate individual from the deceased Ahn.<ref name="Legacy 25" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was released later in 2008, had a "Tuum, Rasi" entry with a picture of the character in ''Legacy'' 25 and biographical details that instead matched the events of ''Legacy'' 2.<ref name="CSWE: Tuum" /> This article has treated the discrepancies in ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' as editorial errors due to the publishing process and the Rasi Tuum in ''Legacy'' 2 as Ahn.
